apps.title: Netflix

apps.title: YouTube TV: Live TV & more

apps.description2:

apps.title: Prime Video

Keep your favorite channels easy to find by arranging their positions on the Roku home screen. Highlight the channel you want to move, open the options menu, select Move Channel, and use the directional buttons to place it where you prefer.

Save time navigating menus by using voice control on a compatible Roku remote or the Roku mobile app. Press and hold the microphone button, speak your request, and release it when finished. Depending on your device and supported features, you can ask Roku to launch a channel, play a title, or search for content.
